text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come for Narita 
Taishin to run in her Make Debut race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seemed rather restless, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the Trainer's heartfelt 
encouragement, her tension finally melted 
away.
